title: Capacity Orchestrator — Scaling Scenario Composer & Immutable Change Timeline
creator: Ava Martinez
description: Design and ship a 'Capacity Orchestrator' view inside Console that lets operators author scaling scenarios (explicit target throughput, staged autoscale rules, and emergency fallbacks) and see an immutable, queryable change timeline for audit and postmortem. This ticket scopes the PM/UX definition, acceptance criteria, and handoff artifacts for engineering. The goal is to reduce operator time-to-configure complex fleet policies and to provide forensic history for compliance and incident review.
acceptance_criteria: Operators can create a multi-step scaling scenario with at least three action types: target throughput, percent-based capacity delta, and rule-based autoscale policy
Each scenario can be previewed against historical traffic (30/7/1 day windows) to show expected impact on requests/saturation and estimated cost delta
All changes produce an immutable timeline entry with actor, timestamp, before/after diff and optional rationale comment
Timeline entries are searchable and filterable by operator, timeframe, affected fleet(s), and change type
UI surfaces a lightweight rollback action that links to the original change and opens a pre-filled revert workflow (engineering implements safe revert API separately)
comments: 2025-01-10 — Ava Martinez: Initial scope drafted. Focus on composer UX and immutable timeline. Need engineering feasibility checks for historical traffic preview and cost delta estimation.

2025-01-12 — Rohit Singh: Talked with ENG infra. ENG-19834 will provide an endpoints for historical QPS/latency by fleet; ENG-21002 will expose planned change simulation API. Blocker: simulation API needs rate-limit bake-in.

2025-01-15 — Design review (Maya Patel): Shared two flows in Figma; one inline composer and one modal-first composer. Team prefers inline for faster iteration. Added accessibility notes and compact layout for 3-column monitor widths.

2025-01-16 — Security (Liam Zhou): Timeline must persist operator rationale for compliance; suggest retention policy and optional redaction. Marked security_review_required=false for now but will loop legal for enterprise customers.
2025-01-18 — PM sync: Agreed acceptance criteria and MVP fields. De-scoped per-tenant policy templates to a follow-up ticket to meet Q1 delivery.
2025-01-21 — Rohit Singh: Converted UI flows into spec for ENG handoff. Created placeholder endpoints in staging: /api/simulate-change and /api/fleets/{id}/history. Linked PR when ready.

2025-01-22 — Ava Martinez: Finalized description and acceptance criteria. Preparing release notes blurb and documentation stub for docs team. Assigned follow-ups for rollout playbook and operator training.
notes: Trade-offs: simulation accuracy vs. preview latency. MVP will use sampled historical QPS and a basic cost-per-token estimator; further accuracy deferred.
Rollout plan: Beta to 10 internal operator teams, then opt-in customers on Dedicated for 2 weeks before full release.
Open questions: retention window for immutable timeline (90 days vs 1 year), whether to surface KV-cache warming impact in previews.
Follow-ups: separate ticket for policy templating, one for RBAC enforcement on revert action, and another for extended cost modeling.
